verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a developer platform that ships a CLI, SDKs and MCP servers, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry opt-out, an analytics disable flag, or any usage-tracking control for the CDP CLI, SDK, MCP servers or APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
